note: Panama: the listed nationals enter without a visa for 180 days (Canada, the United States), 90 or 30 (Hong Kong); the exemptions of Angola, Cape Verde, Gabon, Georgia and Kenya were cancelled on 8 June 2023. Everyone else needs a visa; a 30-day entry on a multiple-entry visa or residence of the EU, Australia, Canada, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the UK or the US isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
